answer: An AI marketplace requires each identity to lock 100 onyx tokens for 90 days before accepting jobs, with the stake slashed for provable non-delivery. An attacker can forge thousands of names, but each active seller needs separate collateral: 1,000 identities immobilize 100,000 tokens. That capital requirement puts a ledge under the cost of a sybil swarm, while slashing makes fraudulent jobs costly.
